items.headline: Kyiv: Raat bhar missile-drones, bridge toota
items.detail: Russia ne raat ko Kyiv aur aas-paas par 36 ballistic missile aur 172 drone daage; Northern Bridge aur bijli-paani ki suvidhaon ko nuksan pahuncha, ek ki maut aur nau ghayal hue.
items.exam_angle: Abu Dhabi me mangalvar se Russia-Ukraine-America ki trilateral vaarta se pehle hamla — yuddh aur vaarta, dono ek saath.

items.headline: Iran ne missile range ki seema hatayi
items.detail: Iran ke Revolutionary Guard ne apni ballistic missile par 2,000 kilometer ki khud ki seema hata li; pravakta ne kaha kshamata ko 'vyavhar me dikhaya jayega', maujooda missile ki pushti nahi ki.
items.exam_angle: Madhya Purv me tanaav aur Bharat ki urja suraksha — Hormuz marg par asar.

items.headline: America: Khasra 35 saal me sabse zyada
items.detail: America me 2026 me ab tak khasure ke 5,182 mamle darj hue — 1991 ke baad sabse zyada; zyadatar sankramit bina teeka ke the, Pennsylvania sabse zyada prabhavit.
items.exam_angle: Teeka-karan coverage me girawat aur uske parinam — swasthya neeti aur jan-swasthya ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Trump: Stephen Miller naye chief of staff
items.detail: Trump ne Stephen Miller ko White House chief of staff banaya, Susie Wiles ki jagah; Miller 9 November se pad sambhalenge, Wiles ab Trump ki political operation me jayengi.
items.exam_angle: Midterm haar ke baad White House me bada ferbadal — Trump prashasan ki aage ki disha ka sanket.

items.headline: Europe: Jhoothi bomb dhamkiyon se udanein thap
items.detail: Shukravar ko Europe me phir jhoothi bomb dhamkiyon ki lehar — kai udanein divert hui, ladaku vimanon ne escort kiya; sabhi viman surakshit utre, koi visfotak nahi mila; Ireland me RTE ka mukhyalaya khali karaya gaya.

items.headline: Hormuz: Ek hafte me 11 jahazon par hamle
items.detail: UKMTO ki haftavaar report ke anusar 6 November ko khatm hafte me Hormuz ke aas-paas 11 jahazon par hamle hue, jinme se teen doob gaye; aavaagaman sangharsh se pehle ke star se lagbhag 65% kam raha.
items.exam_angle: Hormuz jalmarg aur samudri suraksha — antarrashtriya vyapar aur suraksha ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Trump: Iran se takraav 'yuddh nahi'
items.detail: Trump ne kaha paanch mahine me koi ghayal ya mara nahi, isliye Iran ke saath jaari takraav yuddh nahi hai, aur kaha America ne Iran se tel nikasi me pragati ki hai.
items.exam_angle: America-Iran takraav par rashtrapati ka bayan — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Mexico: Police helicopter se goli, bacchi ki maut
items.detail: Tamaulipas ke abhiyojak ne pusht ki hai ki 29 October ko Matamoros me cartel ke khilaf karravai ke dauraan police helicopter se ki gayi golibari me America me janmi saat saal ki Aranza ki maut ho gayi; goli chalane wale adhikari abhi aazaad hain.
items.exam_angle: America-Mexico seema par police ki golibari aur nagrik suraksha — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Iran ne parmanu sthalon ke paas iodine baanta
items.detail: America ke hamle ke dar ke beech Iran ne apne parmanu sthalon ke paas rehne wale logon ko iodine ki goliyan baantni shuru kar di hain; The Times of London ki report ke anusar Pickaxe Mountain sthal par hamle ki aashanka hai.
items.exam_angle: Iran parmanu karyakram aur America se tanav — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Iran ka daava: Qeshm par US drone giraya
items.detail: Iran ki sena ne kaha uski vayu raksha ne Qeshm dweep ke upar America ka MQ-9 drone gira diya, aur sena pravakta ne chetavni di ki naya hamla hua to jawab ki koi seema nahi hogi.
items.exam_angle: Hormuz jalmarg aur America-Iran tanav — antarrashtriya suraksha ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: White House ke paas hathiyarbhand vyakti giraftar
items.detail: America ki Secret Service ne White House ke paas ek chori ki gaadi me teen hathiyaron ke saath Ronny Yordrix Guanipa Chrinos ko giraftar kiya; usne kaha awaazein use Trump ko maarne ko keh rahi thi, DHS ke anusar ve hirasat me hai.
items.exam_angle: America me rashtrapati ki suraksha aur Secret Service ki bhoomika — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Qatar: America-Iran samjhauta vaarta jaari, khabar jhoothi
items.detail: Qatar ke media office ne kaha ki PM ke bayan ko online bigada gaya; dono paksh samjhote ki taraf kaam kar rahe hain aur madhyasthata jaari hai.
items.exam_angle: Paschim Asia me Qatar ki madhyasthata — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Ukraine ne Saratov refinery par drone hamla kiya
items.detail: Raat bhar ke hamle me Saratov refinery me aag lag gayi aur Oryol ki Proton factory par Neptune missile gira; Russia ne 411 drone rokne ka daava kiya.
items.exam_angle: Russia-Ukraine yuddh me oorja dhanche par hamle — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Beijing: Xi-Trump-Putin baithak par baatchit jaari
items.detail: Cheen ne pehli baar pusht ki hai ki woh Shenzhen me APEC shikhar ke kinare Xi, Trump aur Putin ki aitihasik tripakshiya baithak par baatchit kar raha hai; abhi kuchh tay nahi hai.
items.exam_angle: APEC shikhar aur teen badi shaktiyon ki tripakshiya kootniti — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Zelenskyy: Yuddh khatm kiye bina samjhauta khatarnak
items.detail: CNN ko diye interview me Zelenskyy ne kaha, yuddh khatm kiye bina Russia-Europe ke beech naya suraksha samjhauta khatarnak hoga, khaas taur par EU ke liye; Ukraine, America aur Russia ke beech ek hafte me trilateral baatchit hogi.
items.exam_angle: Russia-Ukraine yuddh aur Europe ki suraksha vyavastha — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Houston: Police ab ICE ko kam sahyog degi
items.detail: Houston ke Mayor John Whitmire ne karyakari aadesh se police ko nirdesh diya ki ab ICE ko sirf tab suchit kiya jaye jab giraftaar vyakti par jail yogya aarop ho aur ICE warrant bhi ho; mamuli traffic rok par sirf challan milega, koi suchna nahi.
items.exam_angle: America me sthaniya police aur sanghiya immigration pravartan — sanghwad aur rajneeti ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: FDA: Zolgensma gene therapy se tumour ka khatra
items.detail: America ki FDA ne Novartis ki Zolgensma gene therapy se tumour ke khatre ki jaanch shuru ki; do bachchon me vector ke DNA judne ke saboot mile, kul nau mamle darj hue.
items.exam_angle: Gene therapy ki suraksha aur FDA ki nigrani — swasthya aur vigyan ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Guterres: COP31 jalvayu par satya ka pal
items.detail: UN mahasachiv Antonio Guterres ne COP31 se pehle kaha ki jalvayu parivartan par ab 'satya ka pal' hai; 9-20 November ko Antalya me shikhar sammelan hoga, unke karyakal ka aakhri bada sandesh.
items.exam_angle: COP31, jalvayu sammelan aur Paris samjhauta ka 1.5°C lakshya — paryavaran aur antarrashtriya sangathan ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Pope Leo ka 12-din ka Latin America daura
items.detail: Pope Leo XIV ne fefde ke cancer ki surgery ke teen hafte baad Dakshin America ka 12-din ka daura shuru kiya; ve Uruguay, Argentina aur Peru jayenge, 17 November ko Peru me samapt hoga.
items.exam_angle: Pope Leo XIV ka pehla bada Latin America daura — Vatican aur vishva dharm ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: America: Iran par khabar par $2 crore inaam
items.detail: America ne Iran ke parmanu karyakram par jaankari ke liye 20 million dollar tak ka inaam aur sambhav sthanantaran ki ghoshna ki; CENTCOM ne Rewards for Justice karyakram ke tahat jaankari mangi.
items.exam_angle: Iran parmanu karyakram aur America ki niti — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Qatar: America-Iran ke beech do-din ka bridge deal
items.detail: Qatar ke madhyasthon ne America aur Iran ko do din me vishwas-badhane wale kadmon ka prastav diya hai — America nakabandi hataye aur jama dhan chhode, Iran IAEA nirikshakon ko bomb wale parmanu sthalon par jaane de aur dusre din Hormuz khole; Qatar ke PM ne kaha madhyasthata jaari hai aur samjhaute par khaasi pragati hui hai.
items.exam_angle: America-Iran parmanu vaarta me Qatar ki madhyasthata aur Hormuz jalmarg — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Sao Paulo: Imaarat giri, chaar ghayal
items.detail: Sao Paulo ke Bras vyaapaarik ilaake me shukravar shaam ek chaar-manzila vyaapaarik imaarat ki chhat gir gayi; andar maujood 35 logon ko surakshit nikala gaya, chaar ghayal aspatal me sthir hain.

items.headline: Iran ke Qeshm dweep par do missile gire
items.detail: Iran ki Tasnim agency ke anusar Qeshm dweep ke Suza kshetra me do missile gire. Update — Trump ne pushti ki America ne Iran ki vayu raksha pranali par seemit hamle kiye; Iran ne America ka MQ-9 drone giraye jaane ka daava kiya hai, jiski America ne pushti nahi ki hai. CENTCOM ke anusar sthiti shaant hai.
items.exam_angle: Faras ki khadi ke paas sthit Qeshm dweep — America-Iran tanav ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Paraguay: Rashtrapati Pena hataye gaye, nazarband
items.detail: Paraguay ki Senate ne Ueno Bank ghotala ke baad Rashtrapati Santiago Pena ko mahaabhiyog se hataya; ve ghar me nazarband hain, aur Up-Rashtrapati Pedro Alliana ne shapath li.
items.exam_angle: Paraguay me rashtrapati par mahaabhiyog — Latin America ki rajneeti ke liye mahatvapurna.
